text:
Jamie: Free 34" curved ultrawide (LG) up for grabs — working fine, minor hairline scratch near bottom bezel. Pickup SoMa office, desk area. Photos: https://imgur.com/a/example (1/3). :raised_hands:
Claire: Ooh nice, does it have USB-C power/DisplayPort?
Jamie: USB-C alt-mode + DP. Comes with original stand and power brick. VESA adapter not included.
Samir: I can take it if nobody beats me to it. Can pick up Thu afternoon or Fri lunch.
Taylor: If Samir grabs it I will help carry it to his car :sweat_smile: (I owe him coffee anyway)
Dana: Could you hold it until Friday morning? I'm between desks and would rather not carry it on transit today.
Jamie: Yep I'll hold for Dana until EOD Fri. Please DM me your floor/desk and I'll leave it on the bench by 4pm Friday.
Claire: Quick question — any dead pixels?
Jamie: None that I've seen. Tested with a few color gradients and office whiteboard tasks. Runs at 3440x1440 @ 100Hz.
Samir: If Dana passes, I'm next in line. Otherwise happy to take Friday afternoon.
Dana: Thanks! DM sent.
Taylor: Also, PSA — if you take it and want better ergonomics, there's a free Jarvis desk arm in #random from last month that still hasn't been claimed.
ops-bot: Reminder: please follow office pickup protocol — sign for item on the bench + sanitize hands.
Claire: Also tagging facilities — @facilities for bench reservation?
Jamie: Good call, I put a sticky on the bench but facilities confirmation would be better.
Samir: Will anyone want help carrying it down the stairs? It's kinda deep.
Taylor: I can help at 4:15p on Friday if needed.
Dana: Appreciate it! If something changes I'll update thread.
Jamie: Thanks everyone. If plan changes I will update here. :thumbsup:
